statBattle.title: Stat Battle
statBattle.description: A card battle comparing your card against your opponent's. Pick the higher stat to take their card.
statBattle.roundWin: You won! Took the opponent's card
statBattle.roundLose: You lost... gave up your card
statBattle.roundTie: Tie! Both cards return to their decks
statBattle.gameOverWin: You won! You collected every card
statBattle.gameOverLose: You lost. Your deck ran out of cards
statBattle.gameOverTie: The game ended in a tie
